messages.subject: Possible facet_grid bug
parts:
Does anyone know of a bug in the facet_grid function that would cause
ordered factors not to appear in the right order when a plot is
faceted? I have a histogram of counts of species in different sites,
which are color coded and placed in a specific order. Everything
works fine when I plot a single histogram. But when I try to facet by
site, all the colors are wrong.

I apologize for not coming up with some reproducible code, but suspect
it is either a bug or some sort of new grammar, because I used the
exact same code 8 months ago and it worked fine. I uploaded a ggplot2
update, and now it doesn't work. I'm hoping there's some easy
explanation.

The exact code I'm using is below. If I skip the last line, it works
fine. But if I try to facet with the last line it doesn't work.

library(ggplot2)
estab <-read.csv("estab.data.csv", header=T)
Species <- factor(estab$species, c("PIPO", "ABGR", "PSME", "LAOC",
"JUOC", "PICO"))
Species.Colors <- c("PIPO"="darkgreen", "ABGR"="darkolivegreen4",
"PSME"="forestgreen", "LAOC"="darkolivegreen3",
"JUOC"="darkseagreen4", "PICO"="darkolivegreen")
disturb.plot <- ggplot() +
geom_histogram(data=estab, aes(x=doe, fill=Species), binwidth=5,
position="stack") +
scale_fill_manual(name="Species", values=Species.Colors)
disturb.plot +
theme_bw() +
facet_grid(site~.)
